company.name: Hindalco
company.tag: Makes aluminium and copper in India, and rolled aluminium for cans and cars through Novelis
products: Aluminium metal in ingots, billets and wire rods
Alumina, the white powder aluminium is made from
Copper cathodes and cast copper rod
Gold and silver recovered from copper ore
Specialty alumina for ceramics and flame retardants
Aluminium sheet for drink cans and car bodies (Novelis)
company.productNote: Products named in Hindalco's 2025–26 integrated annual report. Novelis, the world's largest maker of rolled aluminium, is a subsidiary whose results are included in Hindalco's group totals. The pictures are annual-report photographs of Hindalco's people and plants.
